mapper.select: SELECT b.id FROM basecamp_member bm JOIN basecamp b ON b.id = bm.basecamp_id WHERE bm.member_id = #{memberId} AND bm.status = 'ACTIVE' AND b.status IN ('RECRUITING', 'CLOSED', 'CONFIRMED') UNION SELECT b.id FROM basecamp_application a JOIN basecamp b ON b.id = a.basecamp_id WHERE a.applicant_id = #{memberId} AND a.status = 'PENDING' AND b.status IN ('RECRUITING', 'CLOSED', 'CONFIRMED') ORDER BY id
